notes: Own witness from the read lineage-reads-1985/g-01.json: the reader showed the compiler correct at 85 with its probe (p19_bottom.cob), placed as the row's own test; its expected output is the reader's judged run, equal on this build. The read: "An empty area which follows the page body". GR-13.18.34.4-5 (2023 LINAGE integer-4) says only that integer-4 is the number of lines in the bottom margin, not that the area is empty, and its 85 case pb523_linage_margins_on_the_medium_85 reports record positions. The probe, LINAGE 2 LINES AT BOTTOM 2, writes X, Y, Z: X and Y fill the body, lines 3 and 4 are empty, Z begins page 2 at line 5. Code location located after the read: BeginNextLogicalPage advances the rest of the page body plus _bottom empty lines (the LINAGE bottom margin) before the next page starts.
